item.summary: fix(sqlite): isolate read-only snapshot preparation to stop WAL lock drops (#127855) Runs prepareSqliteReadOnlyLocation[Sync] in a short-lived child process so POSIX close() can no longer drop the gateway's WAL locks (the #125744 producer), and adds a Linux WAL sidecar split-brain tripwire that invalidates and evicts a connection whose -wal/-shm fds no longer match the on-disk sidecars. Regression net: F_GETLK lock-survival test plus platform-agnostic smoke/error tests.
